scope: Independent targeted review of HP39 disk host, Kermit final acknowledgements, retained download capacity and controller cancellation

confirmed_before_fix.setup: 15 earlier browser downloads; two typed files in a new HP39 S..B transaction
confirmed_before_fix.observation: Host sent final B ACK; browser rejected second new file at its cumulative 16-file limit.

confirmed_before_fix.setup: Drop first final Y ACK; let independent client reach its negotiated timeout and retransmit G F
confirmed_before_fix.observation: Host completed immediately and ignored the retry; client timed out.

confirmed_before_fix.setup: Drop first B ACK; deliver the retry in the ordinary poll after its timeout
confirmed_before_fix.observation: One-timeout linger expired before retransmission arrived; sender timed out after receiver had published the file.

repairs: Controller includes immutable remaining receive file/byte budget in each request; FileTransfer validates its range before starting a session.

Kermit EOF checks include all uncommitted regular files in the transaction. HP39 checks also include files already received in the active server session. Previously retained browser files stay intact.
Final B and G ACK grace periods are fixed at twice the negotiated timeout, without extending on repeated packets. G retries must match original sequence and command bytes.
An HP39 receive with no selected upload files observes synchronous cancellation before posting its worker start request.
additional_boundaries_checked: Actual timeout retry of Kermit B, persistent HP39 B and HP39 FINISH G succeeds with exactly one delivery/completion.
Expired retries and different G commands/sequences receive no stale ACK.
Zero file capacity and insufficient byte capacity refuse EOF ACK; exact capacity succeeds.
Directory screen output remains available when downloadable file capacity is exhausted.
Malformed, fractional, negative or excessive budgets cannot start a protocol session.
Controller-to-protocol integration for model 1 and model 4 preserves 15 earlier files and rejects a two-file new transaction before second EOF ACK.
limitations: Generated packets validate protocol and host lifecycle boundaries, not a physical cable, optical IrDA, host OS device bridge or every original-firmware transfer mode.
Final current-build stock browser validation remains part of root integration, separate from this review.
